highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 renderer update.
highlights_body: This preview also aligns HarfBuzzSharp generation with the bundled native source.

breaking.title: Unicode combining class enum member renamed
breaking.body: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 is now CCC132 to match the upstream name. Rename source references to CCC132; its numeric value remains unchanged.

breaking.title: GlyphFlags.Defined was removed
breaking.body: The aggregate GlyphFlags.Defined mask is no longer exposed. Combine the concrete glyph flags required by your application instead.

bullets.detail: Brings the current upstream renderer into the 4.154 preview line.

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 introduces the Skia m154 engine update.
